title: Introduce conditional lint router and release-window coordinator to reduce noisy presubmit and protect releases
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Our presubmit lanes run the same full lint/test matrix for all PRs which causes noisy queues and slow feedback for trivial changes. Separately, release automation has tripped twice during externally scheduled maintenance windows. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: a conditional lint router (routes PRs to lightweight vs full lint lanes based on path heuristics, diff size, and opt-in labels) and a release-window coordinator (centralized gate that prevents automated release merges/rollouts during configured blackout windows and retries with backoff). Motivation: speed up developer feedback on small changes, reduce CI cost, and avoid accidental releases during scheduled infra work. Changes in this PR: 1) New presubmit router service (lightweight Go lambda + GH Actions composite) that evaluates changed paths, owned modules, and heuristics (third-party locks, build files) to pick one of: quick-lint, staged-lint, full-lint. 2) Lightweight lint lane implemented as composite actions for fast JS/py style checks and type stubs only. 3) Staged-lint lane for medium changes: run targeted tests and a limited subset of integration tests. 4) Release-window coordinator: central job that reads release windows from repo config (.release-windows.yml) and annotates release PRs to block merge if window active; includes a safe retry/backoff and escalation label. 5) Dep-pruner helper: small script that scans devDependencies in package manifests and flags stale transitive devdeps (optional run as repo-hygiene job). Migration notes and checklist: - [x] Add .release-windows.yml schema and default window (Sundays 02:00-05:00 UTC) - [x] Add `presubmit: lightweight` label and opt-in docs - [x] Add feature flag `CI_ROUTER_ENABLED` (enabled for redwood/* repos by default) - [x] Add monitoring dashboards (console: presubmit-latency, presubmit-cost, release-blocks) Testing performed: unit tests for router heuristics, integration test against a mock GH API, canary rollout of router to 10% of PRs across redwood repo for 48 hours, and a dry-run for release coordinator. Related tickets: ENG-3245 (presubmit refactor), ENG-3301 (release safety improvements). Rollout plan: canary -> 25% -> 100% in 3 days with rollback via feature flag. Links: Linear ENG-3245: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3245/conditional-lint-router and support ticket SUP-1124 for release blackout incidents.
